title: Unable to retrieve the package version for git on preview 1.1.0b2
body:

-->

- **OS version and name**: Linux 5.7.11-1-MANJARO
- **Poetry version**: 1.1.0b2
- **Link of a [Gist](https://gist.github.com/) with the contents of your pyproject.toml file**: https://gist.github.com/serjflint/dfbb4bc8293ebce28b256aa53c22c8ac

## Issue
I need the preview build for solving another bug. But now git packages are not working.
Works as intended on the latest release 1.0.10.
